highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 previews Skia m152 with new Graphite GPU backend bindings and several native leak fixes.
highlights_body: It adds a Vulkan.Silk.NET package, backend-neutral async pixel reads, and fixes several use-after-free and undisposed-resource leaks discovered during a memory audit.

bullets.detail: Brings the bundled Skia engine up to the m152 upstream release line, plus ongoing chrome/m151 and m152 servicing bug-fix merges.
Adds bindings for Skia's Graphite GPU backend across Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
Adds an async RequestReadPixels API to SKImage and SKSurface that works across GPU backends.
Adds the SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package, with Vulkan tests now running on Android and Linux.

Fixes native use-after-free crashes in SKRegion.SpanIterator and SKPixmap.ExtractSubset/With* (both now root their pixel source), an undisposed SKStreamAsset leak in the HarfBuzz blob conversion path, a CoTaskMem pixel-buffer leak on SKImage.Create's raster failure path, and a leaked uniform buffer in SKRuntimeEffectUniforms.Reset().
Uses FreeType for font support on Nano Server.

Removes a defensive Feature[] copy in HarfBuzz Font.Shape, avoids char boxing in SKFourByteTag/Tag.ToString, caches a reflection-based skip-registration check, avoids a double buffer copy in SKData.SaveTo, pre-sizes the SKRuntimeEffectUniforms lookup map, and avoids an intermediate string allocation in GetEncodedText's null-terminated path.
Adds containerized test legs for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: Restored Nano Server font support by switching it to FreeType.
contributor_summaries.mmitche: Fixed the Windows native build to initialize the MSVC environment only once per build.
contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Added the Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn.
